description: This file defines a React context for managing and providing centralized, cached data related to users and sessions in a frontend application. It includes context creation, custom hooks, and a provider component that loads data once on mount, handles loading and error states, and exposes refresh functions.

methods.name: useDataContext
methods.description: Custom hook to consume the DataContext, providing access to users and sessions data along with loading and error states.

methods.name: DataProvider
methods.description: React component that provides the context value, handles initial data loading for users and sessions only once when mounted, and provides refresh functions for updating the data.
